en: A black-and-white aerial view of a large baroque fountain in an open square. The fountain features multiple tiers and statuary, with a central figure holding a trident, likely Neptune. A few small human figures walk around casting long shadows, and a tree canopy appears at the bottom of the image. On the right margin there is printed handwriting-style text identifying the scene.
